These four tiny test fonts were generated for this repository from a triangle path,
a space glyph and a .notdef glyph. They contain no third-party font outlines.
They are test fixtures, not fonts uploaded to or selected for the user's site.

Regenerate using Python with fontTools and Brotli installed:
  python3 tests/fixtures/fonts/generate.py
The checked-in outputs let Node tests run without Python dependencies.
